quote: Other times, it is better to hold an argument forfeited rather than to hold it meritless because that avoids a circuit split, a panel dissent, an en banc poll, a lengthy merits opinion when a short forfeiture one would suffice, or any other waste of judicial resources just to reach the same result.
cite: Megalomedia v. Philadelphia Indemnity, No. 23-20570 (5th Cir. 2026)
